intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Pim, the infirmary’s young helper, runs up holding one hand as far from his face as it will go.

intro.speaker: PIM
intro.text: “A bee got me! The sting’s still in! Is a sting a needle? It’s a needle, isn’t it? Will you need a needle to get it out?”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Hand. It needs a fingernail and ten seconds.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She takes his wrist. Pim makes a noise like a kettle.

options.labelText: “It’s okay, Pim. You’re in very kind hands.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Gloved hands. The dose is one sweet per sting. Two if there’s screaming.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She flicks the sting out. Pim, who watched every second of it, earns the second sweet.

options.labelText: “Pim, look at me. How big was this bee? Show me with your other hand.”

branch.speaker: PIM
branch.text: “This big! It had a *face*! It looked right at me, and then it…”

branch.speaker: PIM
branch.text: “A sweet! Wait. Did I miss the needle part?”
